title: FIREして後悔したことはある？経験者が本音で答える
meta_description: FIREして後悔したことはあるのか。30歳で会社を辞め、2年半だらけた経験や孤独、資産不安を経た本人が、後悔とFIREして良かったことを本音で整理します。
lead: FIREして後悔したことはあります。2年半ゲームに偏って能力が落ちたこと、会社の会話や強制力を失ったこと、もっと早く発信すればよかったこと。それでも、家族との時間と選び直せる自由を考えると、FIRE自体は後悔していません。
thumbnail_prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: 1:1 square Japanese website article thumbnail. Input image: the supplied local PNG is the exact character reference for 「まる」; use the same recognizable character with dark spiky hair, black-rim glasses, expressive face, and white FIRE T-shirt, while freely changing his pose and expression. Create a completely different, emotionally striking composition for an article about regret after FIRE. Show the character standing on a theater stage in front of a huge cracked mirror: one reflection is slumped and regretful, the real character faces the viewer with a wry smile and renewed resolve. Use a spotlight, torn calendar pages, a game controller on the floor, and a bright exit door in the background as visual symbols. Integrate Japanese typography across the mirror crack in a bold red-and-white treatment, not on the left side and not in a bottom banner. Render only these exact phrases, large and crisp: 「FIREして後悔した？」 and 「それでも、やって良かった」. No speech bubbles, no three top callouts, no generic substitute character, no personal name, age, address, phone, email, personal asset amount, watermark, browser frame, or extra readable text.
